name: designer_call_existing_playbook
why: Reference playbook that ALREADY exists on the box: the build has to find it and call it, not rebuild the block.
goal: Build a playbook that runs when an alert is created: ask an analyst to approve blocking the alert's source IP, and if they approve, call our existing playbook named 'Block IP - Shared' with the IP. Do not rebuild the block yourself; that shared playbook already does it and our other playbooks use it too.

requirements.note: trigger is not the designer's own record
